scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Hello there! Welcome to the World of Ragnarok Online. My name is Sprakki and I'm in charge of giving you basic gameplay tips.
Click on the [Next] button or press [Enter] to continue.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
你好！欢迎来到仙境传说。
我是斯普拉奇，负责向你介绍基础的游戏技巧。
点击[下一步]按钮或按[回车]键继续。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
First you need to learn the very basics of controlling your character.
All the basic ^4d4dffmoves, selection of items, and attacks^000000 use the ^4d4dff left click of the mouse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
首先，你需要学习控制角色的基础操作。
所有的^4d4dff移动、物品选择和攻击^000000都使用^4d4dff鼠标左键^000000。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
Click on the ground to move the character.
Attacking monsters and conversations with the people of this world can be done by simply clicking on them.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
点击地面即可移动角色。
攻击魔物或与这个世界的人交谈，只需点击他们即可。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
First off, try moving around.
Do you see that wooden bridge to the right?
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
首先，试着四处走动。
你看到右边那座木桥了吗？

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Walk over that bridge and there's a castle used as the Training Center.
I will be waiting for you inside of that Castle. Please come to the castle by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
走过那座桥，那里有一座用作训练中心的城堡。
我会在城堡里等你。请自己走到城堡来。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You've received a quest from Sprakki.
You can check the contents of the quest in the Quest Info Window.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
你从斯普拉奇那里接到了一个任务。
你可以在任务信息窗口中查看任务内容。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
I will wait inside the Training Center across the bridge.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
我会在桥对面的训练中心等你。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You can open the Quest Info Window by pressing the ^4d4dffAlt + U^000000 keys at the same time.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
你可以同时按下^4d4dffAlt + U^000000键打开任务信息窗口。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Have you checked the Quest Info Window?
I'll be waiting in the castle across the bridge.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
你查看过任务信息窗口了吗？
我会在桥对面的城堡里等你。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
I will be waiting for you across the Bridge to the east.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
我会在东边的桥对面等你。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Are you lost?
Have you gone beyond the bridge to the east?
I will guide you further after we meet in the Training Center.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
你迷路了吗？
你走过东边的桥了吗？
等我们在训练中心见面后，我会继续指导你。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Hello there! Welcome to the World of Ragnarok Online.
My name is Sprakki and I'm in charge of giving you basic gameplay tips.
Click on the [Next] button or press [Enter] key to continue.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
你好！欢迎来到仙境传说。
我是斯普拉奇，负责向你介绍基础的游戏技巧。
点击[下一步]按钮或按[回车]键继续。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
First you need to learn the very basics of controlling your character.
All the basic ^4d4dffmoves, selection of items, and attacks^000000 use the ^4d4dff left click of the mouse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
首先，你需要学习控制角色的基础操作。
所有的^4d4dff移动、物品选择和攻击^000000都使用^4d4dff鼠标左键^000000。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
Click on the ground to move the character.
Attacking monsters and conversations with the people of this world can be done by simply clicking on them.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
点击地面即可移动角色。
攻击魔物或与这个世界的人交谈，只需点击他们即可。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Well then, I will give you a quest to talk to me.
After the conversation is over, talk to me again by left-clicking on me.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
那么，我会给你一个与我交谈的任务。
对话结束后，请再次用鼠标左键点击我。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You've received a quest from Sprakki.
You can check the contents of the quest in the Quest Info Window by pressing the ^4d4dffAlt + U^000000 keys at the same time.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
你从斯普拉奇那里接到了一个任务。
你可以同时按下^4d4dffAlt + U^000000键打开任务信息窗口查看任务内容。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Have you checked the Quest Info Window?
Well, talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
你查看过任务信息窗口了吗？
那么，请再次与我交谈。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Great!
Now you know how to move and talk to others, right?
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
很好！
现在你知道如何移动和与人交谈了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
The Training Center is prepared for novices just like you.
You are going to be trained to get used to the basics of the Game.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
训练中心是为像你这样的初心者准备的。
你将在这里接受训练，熟悉游戏的基础操作。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Of course, this Training Process is optional, if you want to go straight to town, that's also fine.
But, you will miss all the advantages you can get in the Training Center.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
当然，这个训练过程是可选的，如果你想直接去城镇，那也没问题。
但是，你会错过在训练中心能获得的许多优势。

scripts.text: Begin Training.
scripts.translation: 开始训练

scripts.text: Start the game right away.
scripts.translation: 立即开始游戏

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
I will guide you to the Novice Training Center.
Inside, Instructor 'Brade' will be waiting to speak to you.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
我会带你去新手修炼场。
指导员 布雷德正在那里等你，准备与你对话。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Instructor 'Brade' will help you afterwards.
Please, Go see him.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
之后指导员 布雷德会帮助你。
请去见他吧。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff- You received a quest 'Novice Training Ground -1' from Sprakki.
Please check the Quest Info Window. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff- 你从斯普拉奇处接取了任务“新手修炼场 -1”。
请查看任务信息窗口。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Ok, You want to start right away.
Which Town do you want to start at?
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
好的，你想立刻开始。
你想从哪个城镇开始？

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 莫洛奇

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐扬

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Izlude
scripts.translation: 依斯鲁得岛

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
I see.
Go ahead and grow stronger! Look toward a brighter future ahead of you.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
我明白了。
去吧，变得更强！向着更美好的未来前进。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
These are the Novice Training Grounds.
I will guide you to the Novice Training Center.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
这里是新手修炼场。
我会带你去新手修炼中心。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Hello there! Welcome to the World of Ragnarok Online.
You have participated on the previous Training Grounds.
The Training Grounds have now come under new management.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
你好！欢迎来到仙境传说。
你之前参加过训练场。
现在训练场由新的管理者负责了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
I guess we will just have to start your training all over again.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
看来我们得重新开始你的训练了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
My name is Instructor Brade and I'm in charge of giving you basic gameplay tips.
Click on the [Next] button or press [Enter] to continue.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
我是指导员 布雷德，负责教你基础的游戏技巧。
点击[下一页]按钮或按[回车]键继续。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
First you need to learn the very basics of controlling your character.
All the basic ^4d4dff moves, selection of items, and attacks^000000 use the ^4d4dff left click of the mouse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
首先你需要学习控制角色的最基本操作。
所有的^4d4dff移动、选择物品和攻击^000000都使用^4d4dff鼠标左键^000000。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
Click on the ground to move the character.
Attacking monsters and conversations with the people of this world can be done by simply clicking on them.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
点击地面即可移动角色。
攻击魔物或与这个世界的人交谈，只需点击他们即可。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
First off, try moving around.
After moving around, talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
首先，试着移动一下。
移动之后，再跟我对话。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You've received a quest from Instructor Brade.
You can check the contents of the quest in the Quest Info Window.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
你从指导员 布雷德处接取了任务。
你可以在任务信息窗口中查看任务内容。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You can open the Quest Info Window by pressing the ^4d4dffAlt + U^000000keys at the same time.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
你可以同时按下^4d4dffAlt + U^000000键打开任务信息窗口。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Have you checked the Quest Info Window?
Well, talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
你查看任务信息窗口了吗？
好了，再跟我对话。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Great.
You've completed the given quest successfully, so I will reward you with experience points.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
很好。
你成功完成了任务，所以我会奖励你经验值。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Experience Points you've earned from hunting or finishing quests can be checked by tracking the EXP Bar, located at upper-left side of the display.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
你通过狩猎或完成任务获得经验值，可以通过查看屏幕左上角的经验条来确认。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Sigh... I will just talk roughly.
...I just can't get used to 'politeness' you know.
Don't look at me like that!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
唉...我就随便说说吧。
...我就是不习惯那么“客气”，你知道的。
别那样看着我！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Ok look alive you maggot.
Next up is items and equipment.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
好了，你这蛆虫，打起精神来。
接下来是物品和装备。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
First, take these.
These are very basic equipments and recovery potions.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
首先，拿着这些。
这些是非常基础的装备和恢复药水。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Uh... Where were we? Oh right, let's continue.
It's about items and equipments.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
呃...我们说到哪了？哦对了，继续。
是关于物品和装备的。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Take these.
Basic equipments and recovery potions.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
拿着这些。
基础的装备和恢复药水。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
In the upper left Basic Info. Window, press the 'Item' icon to open the Item Window.
The item window is divided into...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
在左上角的基本信息窗口，点击“物品”图标即可打开物品窗口。
物品窗口分为...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
3 sections: consumable items, equipment and other items.
If you want to use or equip items, just double-click on the item or drag them into the Equipment Window.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
三个部分：消耗品、装备和其他物品。
如果你想使用或装备物品，只需双击该物品，或将其拖入装备窗口即可。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
You can see detailed info. of each item by right-clicking on the item.
Detailed information of the item will pop up.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
右键点击物品可以查看其详细信息。
物品的详细信息会弹出来。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Right-click on an item to see detailed information about it.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
右键点击物品以查看其详细信息。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Right-click on other players to show the Community Menu and you can join a party, or request trade with a player etc.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
右键点击其他玩家以显示社区菜单，你可以加入队伍，或向玩家请求交易等。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Why don't you equip the items I gave you earlier?
^4d4dffDouble-Click^000000 on the item you want to equip. Let us continue after you are done gearing up.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
为什么不把之前给你的物品装备上呢？
^4d4dff双击^000000你想装备的物品。等你装备好我们再继续。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Items can be easily equipped or used by simply double-clicking on them.
The Hot Key to open the Inventory Window is ALT + E.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
只需双击物品即可轻松装备或使用。
打开物品窗口的快捷键是 ALT + E。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
To check on the items that are currently equipped, use the Hot Key ALT + Q.
Or, drag the item on to the item slot you want the item to be equipped.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
要查看当前已装备的物品，请使用快捷键 ALT + Q。
或者，将物品拖到你想要装备它的物品槽位上。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Equip all of the equipment given by Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
装备指导员 布雷德给你的所有装备。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Try to put on at least 4 of the equipments I gave you.
Put those shoes on, wear those clothes, and arm yourself with that weapon you maggot.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
试着至少穿上我给你的4件装备。
穿上那双长靴，穿上那套衣服，拿起那把武器，你这蛆虫。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
You are all set.
You are coming along just fine.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
你准备好了。
你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Here's some Fly Wings and Butterfly Wings as a reward.
You don't need these in the Training Ground, but they will come in handy later.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
这是给你的奖励：苍蝇翅膀和蝴蝶翅膀。
你在训练场用不到这些，但以后会派上用场。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Next, are Hot Keys.
Press the ^4d4dffF12 key^000000 on your keyboard.
A box with 9 slots will pop up.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
接下来是快捷键。
按下键盘上的 ^4d4dffF12 键^000000。
会弹出一个有9个槽位的窗口。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Drag on the right corner of the Hot Key Window and you will be able to see the other pages of the Hot Key.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
拖动快捷键窗口的右下角，你就可以看到快捷键的其他页面。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
The F1 to F9 keys are the designated hotkeys.
Just drag a skill or an item onto the Hot Key Window and press a corresponding key to use them right away.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
F1 到 F9 键是指定的快捷键。
只需将技能或物品拖到快捷键窗口，然后按下对应的键即可立即使用。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
You can register a skill or an item to the Hot Key Window by just dragging them onto the Hot Key Slot.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
只需将技能或物品拖到快捷键槽位，即可将其注册到快捷键窗口。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Registered Skills or Items can be used/equipped by just pressing the corresponding key.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
已注册的技能或物品可以通过按下对应的键来使用/装备。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
You can customize the Hot Key to use any keys you please as the Hot Key by changing the Shortcut configuration in the options menu.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
你可以在选项菜单中更改快捷方式设置，以自定义快捷键，使用你喜欢的任何按键作为快捷键。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Register skills and items that you use often so that you can use them easily.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
注册你经常使用的技能和物品，以便轻松使用。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
The last part is how to use Skills.
But before that, you need to learn something first.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
最后一部分是关于如何使用技能。
但在开始之前，你需要先学习一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Somewhere in this room, there's someone named ^4d4dffJinha^000000.
Find Jinha and learn the ^4d4dff[First Aid]^000000 skill from him.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
这个房间的某个地方，有一位名叫^4d4dff振河^000000的人。
找到振河，并向他学习^4d4dff[紧急治疗]^000000技能。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Your lesson is after that.
Go find Jinha and learn the [First Aid] Skill. Then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
你的课程在那之后开始。
去找振河学习[紧急治疗]技能，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Somewhere in this room, there's someone named ^4d4dffJinha^000000.
Find Jinha and learn the ^4d4dff[First Aid]^000000 skill from him.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
这个房间的某个地方，有一位名叫^4d4dff振河^000000的人。
找到振河，并向他学习^4d4dff[紧急治疗]^000000技能。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Now you've learned the [First Aid] Skill.
Just as I told you before, by registering the First Aid Skill onto the Hot Key Window, you can use the skill fast and easy.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
现在你已经学会了[紧急治疗]技能。
正如我之前告诉你的，将紧急治疗技能注册到快捷键窗口，就可以快速且轻松地使用它。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
And that's it, that's all I can teach you.
You see that exit to the west?
Move on to the next room and there will be another instructor waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
就是这样，我能教你的都教完了。
看到西边的那个出口了吗？
前往下一个房间，那里会有另一位指导员等着你。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
We will be seeing each other soon enough.
But for now, go to the room to the west and get more information.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
我们很快就会再见的。
但现在，请去西边的房间获取更多信息。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
You've come along fine this far.
This is not much, but take this as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
你这一路表现得很不错。
虽然不多，但请收下这个作为奖励。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Next step of the Training is done in the room west of here.
If you are lost, I can send you there.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
训练的下一步是在这里的西边房间进行的。
如果你迷路了，我可以把你传送过去。

scripts.text: I can get there by myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己能过去

scripts.text: Please, send me to the next room.
scripts.translation: 请把我传送到下一个房间

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Good. That's the attitude you must have.
You can't just lean on others to help you.
Now, go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
很好，这才是应有的态度。
你不能总是依赖别人的帮助。
现在，去吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Oh well.
I think it's better than seeing you lost and wandering about.
Hahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
好吧。
我觉得这总比看着你迷路乱走好。
哈哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Aren't you done with the courses here?
Or are you just lost?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
你还没完成这里的课程吗？
还是说只是迷路了？

scripts.text: Send me to the Combat Training Ground.
scripts.translation: 把我传送到战斗训练场

scripts.text: I want to go to town.
scripts.translation: 我想去城镇

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Sure.
Be careful not to be lost again.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
好的。
小心别再迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Town... Eh?
In that case, I will send you to where the Kafra Employee is at.
Use ^4d4dffKafra's Warp Service^000000 to go to town.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 布雷德]
城镇... 咦？
那样的话，我会把你传送到卡普拉 职员所在的地方。
使用^4d4dff卡普拉的传送服务^000000前往城镇。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
What can I help you with?
Hmm? You haven't followed the curriculum correctly.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
有什么可以帮你的吗？
嗯？你没有按照正确的课程顺序来。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
You have to see Instructor Brade first before me. I will send you to Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
你必须先见指导员 布雷德，然后才能见我。我会把你传送到指导员 布雷德那里。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Hello!
I am responsible for teaching you the [First Aid] skill.
Instructor Brade asked you to learn it right?.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
你好！
我负责教你[紧急治疗]技能。
指导员 布雷德让你来学习这个技能，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Wow... ...it's amazing!
You already know the First Aid Skill.
There doesn't seem to be anything for me to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
哇... ...太厉害了！
你已经会[紧急治疗]技能了。
看来没什么需要我教你的了。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Great. Was your instructor from the previous management Cecil?
Well, you have learned First Aid, I can confirm that.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
很好。你之前的教官是塞西尔吗？
嗯，你已经学会了[紧急治疗]，我可以确认这一点。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Well, you can directly go to the next step of the course.
Go back to Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
那么，你可以直接进行课程的下一步了。
回到指导员 布雷德那里吧。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Hello!
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[振河]
你好！
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I want to learn to use the [First Aid] Skill.
scripts.translation: 我想学习[紧急治疗]技能

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
That's right.
First Aid is the skill used to convert SP into HP when you are in danger.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
没错。
[紧急治疗]是在你陷入危险时，将SP转化为HP的技能。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
It's recovery amount is small.
Still, it will help you not to faint from a critical hit.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
它的恢复量很小。
不过，它能帮你避免被重击击倒。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
You can open the Skill Window by pressing the ^4d4dffskill^000000 button in the Basic Window.
Hot Key is ^4d4dffALT + S^000000.
Why don't you try the skill?
scripts.translation:
[振河]
你可以按基本窗口中的^4d4dff技能^000000按钮打开技能窗口。
快捷键是^4d4dffALT + S^000000。
要不要试着使用一下这个技能？

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Good, now you know how to use the First Aid Skill, you have to move on to the next step.
Go back to Instructor Brade and show him what you've learned here.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
很好，既然你已经知道如何使用[紧急治疗]技能了，就必须进入下一步了。
回到指导员 布雷德那里，向他展示你在这里学到的东西。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Didn't you learn the First Aid Skill already?
Have it checked by Instructor Brade.
If you don't know how to get to him, I will send you to him.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
你不是已经学过[紧急治疗]技能了吗？
让指导员 布雷德检查一下。
如果你不知道怎么去找他，我可以把你传送过去。

scripts.text: I'm good by myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己没问题

scripts.text: Please, send me to him.
scripts.translation: 请把我传送过去

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Very Good!
That's the right attitude!
You will be a great adventurer in the future.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
非常好！
这就是正确的态度！
你将来一定会成为一名出色的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
I will send you to Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
我会把你传送到指导员 布雷德那里。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
What can I do for you?
Next course will be continued in the West Room.
Go on into the west room.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
有什么可以帮你的吗？
下一阶段的课程将在西边的房间进行。
请前往西边的房间。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Hmm? Strange.
Let me see that Trainee ID for a sec.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
嗯？奇怪。
让我看看你的学员证。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Oh, really...
You have participated on the previous Training Grounds.
The Training Grounds have now come under new management.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
哦，原来是这样...
你参加过之前的训练场。
训练场现在由新的管理层接管了。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
If you want to do the basic course,
you should go back to Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
如果你想进行基础课程，
你应该回到指导员 布雷德那里。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Or you can go ahead and start with theory training.
What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
或者你可以直接开始理论训练。
你想怎么做？

scripts.text: Send me to Basic Training.
scripts.translation: 把我传送到基础训练

scripts.text: Start Theory Training.
scripts.translation: 开始理论训练

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Sure.
I will send you to Instructor Brade.
Instructor Brade will start your basic training.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
好的。
我会把你送到指导员 布雷德那里。
指导员 布雷德会开始你的基础训练。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
I will tell you about the people you will be seeing in Town.
There are many kinds of people in town and some of them will be helpful to know.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我会告诉你一些在城镇里会见到的人。
城镇里有很多不同种类的人，认识其中一些会对你的冒险有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
There are a lot of people in town, but among them, these people are the most important to know.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
城镇里有很多人，但其中这几位是最需要认识的。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
They are [Kafra] Employee's standing right behind me and their rival company the [Cool Event Corp].
When you visit a town for the first time, you should talk to the Information [Guide]
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
站在我身后的是[卡普拉]的员工，以及他们的竞争对手[酷活动公司]。
当你第一次来到一个城镇时，应该先和资讯向导交谈。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Well then, let's hear from each of them.
Start by talking to the [Kafra] Employee.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
那么，让我们听听他们各自的介绍吧。
先从身后的[卡普拉]员工开始。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff- You've received a quest from Chocolat.
Please check the quest information window. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff- 你从巧克力那里接到了一个任务。
请查看任务信息窗口。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
You were still on the basic course.
You should go back to Instructor Brade or Jinha.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
你之前还在基础课程阶段。
你应该回到指导员 布雷德或振河那里。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
If you don't know how to find them, I can send you to Instructor Brade, How about it?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
如果你不知道他们在哪里，我可以把你送到指导员 布雷德那里，怎么样？

scripts.text: I will go myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己去

scripts.text: Will you do that for me?
scripts.translation: 请帮我传送

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Sure. Go out to the door to the right.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
好的。请走到右边的门口。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Sure.
I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
好的。
我们回头见。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
I will tell you about the people you will be seeing in Town.
There are many kinds of people in town and some of them will be helpful to know.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我会告诉你一些在城镇里会见到的人。
城镇里有很多不同种类的人，认识其中一些会对你的冒险有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
There are a lot of people in town, but among them, these people are the most important to know.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
城镇里有很多人，但其中这几位是最需要认识的。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
They are [Kafra] Employee's standing right behind me and their rival company the [Cool Event Corp].
When you visit a town for the first time, you should talk to Information [Guide]
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
站在我身后的是[卡普拉]的员工，以及他们的竞争对手[酷活动公司]。
当你第一次来到一个城镇时，应该先和资讯向导交谈。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Well then, let's hear from each of them.
Start by talking to the [Kafra] Employee.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
那么，让我们听听他们各自的介绍吧。
先从身后的[卡普拉]员工开始。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Here, talk to these guys standing behind me.
Start with the [Kafra] Employee behind me.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
来，和站在我身后的这些人交谈吧。
先从身后的[卡普拉]员工开始。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
You've learned a lot about Kafra service huh?
From now on, you can use the Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
看来你已经对卡普拉服务了解不少了。
从现在开始，你可以使用卡普拉服务了。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
During the Training Process, if you want to go straight to the town, you can use the Kafra Service to go there.
But, once you leave the Training Center, you can never come back here.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
在训练过程中，如果你想直接前往城镇，可以使用卡普拉服务传送过去。
但是，一旦离开训练中心，你就再也无法回到这里了。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Next is the Kafra's rival, [Cool Event Corp.] Staff!
[Cool Event Corp.] Staff specialize in events.
Well, why don't you talk to him yourself?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
接下来是卡普拉的竞争对手，[酷活动公司]的职员！
[酷活动公司]的职员专门负责活动。
嗯，你自己去和他谈谈吧？

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
After [Kafra] and [Cool Event Corp.], are the Information [Guide]'s.
They can seem insignificant but they can help you greatly when the time comes.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
在[卡普拉]和[酷活动公司]之后，就是资讯向导了。
他们看起来可能不起眼，但在关键时刻能给你很大的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
I've brought the Information Guide from the City of Prontera.
Ask him what he actually does in town.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我从普隆德拉城请来了这位资讯向导。
问问他在城镇里具体是做什么的。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
How was the explanation of the Information [Guide]?
Last is about using [Inn]s.
There's an Inn located in each town.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
资讯向导的介绍怎么样？
最后是关于使用[旅馆]的。
每个城镇都有一家旅馆。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
You can rest at Inns or Hotels for a small fee.
Your HP and SP will be recovered completely by resting there.
Can't hurt to use one, eh?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
你可以支付少量费用在旅馆或酒店休息。
在那里休息可以完全恢复HP和SP。
用一下也无妨，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Besides these guys, there's many merchants selling various kind of items, so go check them out.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
除了这些人之外，还有很多商人出售各种物品，所以去看看他们吧。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
You've completed all the quests I gave you.
As the reward, I will give you Free Tickets for Kafra Storage and Teleport Service.
They will come in handy.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
你已经完成了我交给你的所有任务。
作为奖励，我会给你卡普拉仓库和瞬间移动服务的免费券。
它们会很有用的。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
That's all for me.
Now, it's time for real combat!
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我的部分就到这里了。
现在，是时候进行真正的战斗了！

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Real Combat Training will be given by Instructor Brade. You met him earlier.
I will send you to the Real Combat Training Field.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
真正的战斗训练将由指导员 布雷德负责。你之前见过他。
我会把你送到实战训练场。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Are you lost?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
你迷路了吗？

scripts.text: No, just looking around
scripts.translation: 没有，只是四处看看

scripts.text: Yes, send me to the Combat Training Field
scripts.translation: 是的，请把我送到实战训练场

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Okay, come back to me if
you need me to redirect you.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
好的，如果你需要我带你去别的地方，就回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
I will send you to the Real Combat Training Field.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我会把你送到实战训练场。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello.
I don't think it's my turn yet.
Please talk to 'Chocolat' first.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
你好。
我觉得现在还没轮到我。
请先和“巧克力”谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello.
I've been dispatched by the Kafra Head Office to help trainees.
The Kafra Corporation is the world's largest company with a long and distinguished history on the Midgard continent.
It's important for you adventurers to be close with us.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
你好。
我是由卡普拉总公司派来帮助学员的。
卡普拉公司是米德加尔特大陆上历史悠久、声名显赫的最大企业。
对于你们冒险者来说，与我们保持亲近是很重要的。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I will inform you about the Kafra Services which you will be using most frequently, [Save], [Storage] and [Teleport] Services.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
我会向你介绍你最常使用的卡普拉服务：[存档]、[仓库]和[瞬间移动]服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
When you talk to a Kafra Employee and ask for the Save Service,
the location of where you will revive, after being defeated in battle, will be changed.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
当你和卡普拉 职员交谈并请求存档服务时，
你在战斗中战败后复活的地点将会改变。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Your Respawn Point is always the last place where you have saved. Using a Butterfly Wing will return you to the place where you last saved.
This service is free to use, so feel free to use the Save Service anytime you like.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
你的复活点始终是你最后一次存档的地方。使用蝴蝶翅膀会返回你最后一次存档的地方。
这项服务是免费的，所以请随时使用存档服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Do you want to hear another explanation?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
你想听另一个介绍吗？

scripts.text: About Save
scripts.translation: 关于存档

scripts.text: About Storage
scripts.translation: 关于仓库

scripts.text: About Teleport
scripts.translation: 关于瞬间移动

scripts.text: About Cart
scripts.translation: 关于手推车

scripts.text: No More.
scripts.translation: 没有了

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I hope you are satisfied with my explanation
about the Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
希望您对卡普拉服务的介绍感到满意。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Kafra Service at your service.
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
卡普拉服务随时为您效劳。
请问有什么可以帮您的？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Let me inform you before you use the Teleport Service.
If you teleport to the village,
^4d4dffyou can NEVER come back to the Novice Training Field.^000000
So keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
在使用瞬间移动服务之前，请允许我提醒您。
如果您传送到村庄，
^4d4dff您将永远无法返回初心者训练场。^000000
请务必记住这一点。

scripts.text: Teleport Service
scripts.translation: 瞬间移动服务

scripts.text: About Kafra Service
scripts.translation: 关于卡普拉服务

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
So, you are going straight to town.
Let me give you a brief introduction.
^4d4dffProntera is the Capital City of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, and right next to it is Izlude^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
那么，您是要直接前往城镇。
让我为您做一个简单的介绍。
^4d4dff普隆德拉是卢恩·米德加兹王国的首都，而依斯鲁得岛就在它旁边。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^4d4dffMorocc is the Desert City, you can change your job to Thief and Assassin^000000 here.
^4d4dffPayon is the Village in the Mountains, and it is close to the Archer Village^000000.
^4d4dffGeffen is the City of Magic. Go there if you want to become a Mage.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
^4d4dff莫洛奇是沙漠之城，您可以在此转职为盗贼或刺客。^000000
^4d4dff斐扬是山中的村庄，靠近弓箭手村。^000000
^4d4dff吉芬是魔法之城。如果您想成为魔法师，请前往那里。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^4d4dffAlberta is the Port City and there you can find the Merchant Guild^000000.
Also, if you are trying to take a boat to go somewhere, you have to go through Alberta first.
Select the town you want to teleport to.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
^4d4dff艾尔贝塔是港口城市，那里有商人公会。^000000
此外，如果您想乘船前往其他地方，必须先经过艾尔贝塔。
请选择您想要传送到的城镇。

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 莫洛奇

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐扬

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Rune-Midgarts' Capital, Prontera.
I will send you to Prontera.
May Freya bless you upon your journey.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
卢恩·米德加兹的首都，普隆德拉。
我将送您前往普隆德拉。
愿芙蕾雅女神保佑您的旅途。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Desert City, Morocc...
It has lost it's former glory...
Do not lose the dream in your heart right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
沙漠之城，莫洛奇...
它已失去了往日的辉煌...
请不要失去心中的梦想。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hmm, you want to be an Archer?.
Let's go to Payon.
Let Freya bless you.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
嗯，您想成为弓箭手吗？
让我们去斐扬吧。
愿芙蕾雅女神保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Port City, Alberta.
Main city for all trades on the Midgard continent.
If you want to experience other civilizations, you have to visit Alberta first.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
港口城市，艾尔贝塔。
米德加尔特大陆所有贸易的主要城市。
如果您想体验其他文明，必须先访问艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The City of Magic!
Geffen Tower is looking nice standing in the middle of Geffen City.
I will send you close to the Geffen fountain.
May Goddess Freya bless you!.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
魔法之城！
吉芬塔矗立在吉芬城的中央，景色宜人。
我将送您到吉芬喷泉附近。
愿芙蕾雅女神保佑您！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I will explain about the Kafra Service.
Which Service do you want to be
informed about?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
我将为您介绍卡普拉服务。
您想了解哪项服务？

scripts.text: About Save
scripts.translation: 关于存档

scripts.text: About Storage
scripts.translation: 关于仓库

scripts.text: About Teleport
scripts.translation: 关于瞬间移动

scripts.text: About Cart
scripts.translation: 关于手推车

scripts.text: No More.
scripts.translation: 没有了

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I hope you are satisfied with my explanation
about the Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
希望您对卡普拉服务的介绍感到满意。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
When you are killed in a battle,
you can revive in the location you saved with this service.
If you save at a Kafra in each village
You can revive in the village you saved.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
当您在战斗中死亡时，
您可以使用此服务在存档点复活。
如果您在每个村庄的卡普拉处存档，
您就可以在存档的村庄复活。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Saved location is always where
you saved last, and by using a Butterfly Wing,
you can teleport directly to your saved point.
So feel free to use this service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
存档点始终是您最后一次存档的位置，
通过使用蝴蝶翅膀，
您可以直接传送到存档点。
请随意使用此服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Next is about using the Storage Service.
You can store and retrieve your items in any town at your convenience.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
接下来是关于仓库服务的使用。
您可以方便地在任何城镇存取物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
It's unreasonable to carry all of your items with you when you don't need them right away.
Please use our Storage and keep your items safe and secure.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
当您不需要立即使用所有物品时，随身携带它们是不合理的。
请使用我们的仓库，确保您的物品安全。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Our convenient Storage Service
is provided to our customers for a small fee which is different from town to town.
However, you must be
at least ^3355FFBasic Skill Level 6^000000
to use the Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
我们便捷的仓库服务
向顾客收取少量费用，费用因城镇而异。
但是，您必须达到
^3355FF基本技能等级 6^000000
才能使用仓库。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
There are 7 different item sections of the Storage into which items are organized: Consumable, Kafra (Item Mall), Armor, Weapons, Ammo, Cards, and Etc items.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
仓库分为7个不同的物品栏，物品按类别整理：消耗品、卡普拉（商城）、防具、武器、弹药、卡片和其他物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
There are a maximum of {0} Inventory Slots in Kafra Storage, meaning you can have up to {1} different kinds of items in Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
卡普拉仓库最多有{0}个物品栏位，
这意味着您最多可以在仓库中存放{1}种不同的物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
If you have a Premium Subscription, the maximum Inventory Slots in Kafra Storage is {0}!
Remember though, that in the case of Equipment, each item takes up one Inventory Slot.
The maximum number of items that can be placed in Kafra Storage is 30,000.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
如果您拥有高级订阅，卡普拉仓库的物品栏位上限为{0}！
不过请记住，对于装备类物品，每件物品都会占用一个物品栏位。
卡普拉仓库最多可存放30,000件物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
There are a maximum of {0} Inventory Slots in Kafra Storage, meaning you can have up to {1} different kinds of items in Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
卡普拉仓库最多有{0}个物品栏位，
这意味着您最多可以在仓库中存放{1}种不同的物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
This Storage is shared by every character on one account.
Storage Fees can be vary for each Town.
So please keep that in mind when you are using our storage service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
该仓库由同一账号下的所有角色共享。
仓库费用因城镇而异。
因此，在使用我们的仓库服务时，请务必留意这一点。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We also provide you with a Teleport Service to make your trips easier when you are trying to move a long distance.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
我们还提供传送服务，
以便您在长距离移动时更加便捷。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
With our veteran teleporter's skill,
your trip will be safer and more comfortable.
Oh and remember that the places you can teleport to vary from town to town.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
凭借我们资深传送员的技术，
您的旅程将更加安全舒适。
哦，请记住，可传送的目的地因城镇而异。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
This is all for your never ending
support. We are working hard to
repay our dept to our customers.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
这一切都是为了回报您无尽的支持。
我们正在努力偿还对顾客的亏欠。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Kafra corporation provides Cart rental services
to customers engaged in commercial business.
Originally this cart rental service had been only provided
by the merchant guild in Alberta
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
卡普拉公司为从事商业活动的顾客提供手推车租赁服务。
最初，这项手推车租赁服务仅由艾尔贝塔的商人公会提供。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
However, since we took over this service
our merchant customers have been able to rent carts from almost anywhere.
The cart rental service is available only for job classes engaged in commercial business
such as ^4d4dffMerchants, Blacksmiths, Alchemists, and Super Novices^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
然而，自我们接管这项服务以来，
我们的商人顾客几乎可以在任何地方租用手推车。
手推车租赁服务仅面向从事商业活动的职业，
例如^4d4dff商人、铁匠、炼金术士和超级初心者^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Of course you should learn the 'Pushcart' skill beforehand,
otherwise you will not be able to rent a cart from us.
The rental fee varies by town,
please keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
当然，您必须事先学会“手推车使用”技能，
否则将无法从我们这里租用手推车。
租赁费用因城镇而异，
请务必留意。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
This is not my turn.
have you finished talking to the Kafra Employee yet?
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
还没轮到我呢。
你和卡普拉 职员谈完了吗？

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Hello.
We are working hard to provide events on Midgard similar to the Kafra services.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
你好。
我们正在努力在米德加尔特提供类似卡普拉服务的活动。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Our staff is here to support you with [storage], [save] and [teleport service].
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
我们的职员将为您提供[仓库]、[存档]和[传送服务]的支持。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
If there's no Kafra around you, we're around to help you.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
如果身边没有卡普拉，我们会在这里为您提供帮助。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
We are working hard on a network of Events to make your life better.
I hope that you can meet our staff in Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
我们正在努力构建一个活动网络，以改善您的生活。
希望您能在艾尔贝塔见到我们的职员。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Who knows, we might meet outside of this academy.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
谁知道呢，我们也许会在学院之外相遇。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Mostly all of us wear red coats in the places that the Kafra Employee's don't work in.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
在卡普拉 职员无法工作的地方，我们大多数人都会穿红色外套。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Most of our services are similar to those of the Kafra Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
我们的大多数服务都与卡普拉总公司类似。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
It ain't my turn yet.
Listen to Chocolat.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
还没轮到我呢。
请听巧克力说。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Guides are in each town to guide you to useful places.
Ask us where you want to go and we'll mark your mini maps with a ^4d4dff+^000000.
Don't hesitate to ask us questions.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
每个城镇都有向导，指引您前往有用的地方。
告诉我们要去的地方，我们会在您的小地图上标记一个^4d4dff+^000000。
请随时向我们提问。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
We all don't look the same in every town but our roles are the same.
Take note of this whenever you go to a new town.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
我们在每个城镇的外貌可能不同，但职责是一样的。
每到一个新城镇，请留意这一点。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
If you want to go to your first town, you can ask the Kafra Employee to the left.
You can move there with the Teleport Service.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
如果您想去第一个城镇，可以询问左边的卡普拉 职员。
您可以使用瞬间移动服务前往那里。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
What can I help you with?
Need me to explain what I do again?
scripts.translation:
[向导]
有什么可以帮您的吗？
需要我再解释一遍我的职责吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I need an explanation.
scripts.translation: 是的，我需要解释。

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不感兴趣

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Guides are in each town to guide you to useful places in each town.
Ask us where you want to go and we'll mark your mini maps with a ^4d4dff+^000000.
Don't hesitate to ask us questions.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
每个城镇都有向导，指引您前往城镇中有用的地方。
告诉我们要去的地方，我们会在您的小地图上标记一个^4d4dff+^000000。
请随时向我们提问。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
We all don't look the same in every town but our roles are the same.
Take note of this whenever you go to a new town.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
我们在每个城镇的外貌可能不同，但职责是一样的。
每到一个新城镇，请留意这一点。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
If you want to go to your first town, you can ask the Kafra Employee to the left.
You can move there with the Teleport Service.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
如果您想去第一个城镇，可以询问左边的卡普拉 职员。
您可以使用瞬间移动服务前往那里。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Ok well talk to Chocolat if you're done talking with us.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
好的，如果您和我们的对话结束了，请去和巧克力谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
You have participated on the previous Training Grounds.
The Training Grounds have now come under new management.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
您之前参加过训练场。
训练场现在由新管理层接管了。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Do you want to do the basic course,
or do you just want to go through from here?
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
您想从基础课程开始，
还是想直接从这里开始？

scripts.text: Send me to Basic Training.
scripts.translation: 把我传送到基础训练

scripts.text: I'll start from here.
scripts.translation: 我从这里开始。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Ok. I'll send you to the basic course.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
好的。我将把您送到基础课程。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Then we will start your training.
I'll write down the registration form.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
那么我们将开始您的训练。
我会填写注册表。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
I think you came back from theory training course,
can I send you back to there or do you just want to go through from here?
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
我想您是从理论训练课程回来的，
我可以把您送回去，还是您想直接从这里开始？

scripts.text: Send me back to Chocolat.
scripts.translation: 把我送回巧克力那里。

scripts.text: I'll start from here.
scripts.translation: 我从这里开始。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Ok. I'll send you to Chocolat.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
好的。我将把您送到巧克力那里。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Then we will start your training.
I'll write down the registration form.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
那么我们将开始您的训练。
我会填写注册表。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Welcome.
Now this is real practice.
We can practice real battle here.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
欢迎。
现在这是真正的实战。
我们可以在这里练习真正的战斗。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
As I explained the first time, we can click on the monsters.
One attack per click.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
正如我第一次解释的那样，我们可以点击魔物。
每次点击攻击一次。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
For convenience,
^4d4dffIf you hold down the Ctrl key,^000000 while attacking, you will automatically attack.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
为了方便，
^4d4dff如果您按住Ctrl键，^000000在攻击时，您将自动攻击。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
You can also set this mode before battle by typing ^4d4dff[ /nc ]^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
您也可以在战斗前通过输入^4d4dff[ /nc ]^000000来设置此模式。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Then, let's go Poring hunting.
Please hunt 'Poring's on Level 1 of the training grounds.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
那么，让我们去猎杀波利吧。
请在训练场第1层猎杀“波利”。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff- You've received a quest from Instructor Brade.
Please check the quest information window. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff- 您从指导员 布雷德那里接到了一个任务。
请查看任务信息窗口。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Brade]
You can see it is not so hard, huh?
Nice job.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
您可以看到这并不难，对吧？
干得好。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Kill enough Porings.
Porings are easy to deal with, so cheer up.
Try again.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
击杀足够数量的波利。
波利很容易对付，所以加油。
再试一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Now all of the courses are almost done.
You are a Novice, and you can't get any jobs yet.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
现在所有的课程都差不多结束了。
您是初心者，目前还不能转职。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
If you acquire all of basic skills with JOB Level 10, you can change your job.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
如果您在职业等级10时习得了所有基本技能，就可以转职了。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
The first Job classes are defined into 6 classes.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
第一职业被划分为6个职业。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
The 6 basic jobs are
Swordman, Thief,
Acolyte, Mage,
Archer and Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
6个基础职业分别是
剑士、盗贼、
服事、魔法师、
弓箭手和商人。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Let's experience the basic 6 jobs, Swordman, Thief, Acolyte, Mage, Archer and Merchant and see what those jobs can do.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
让我们来体验一下这6个基础职业：剑士、盗贼、服事、魔法师、弓箭手和商人，看看它们各自能做什么。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Behind me, there are people dispatched from each of the basic Job Guilds.
These people will give you instruction manuals that allow you to experience some limited skills of each job.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
在我身后，有来自各个基础职业公会的代表。
这些人会给您提供说明书，让您体验每个职业的部分技能。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Equip a manual of the job which you want to experience, and you will be able to use some basic skills of that corresponding job.
Try those skills and decide which job to choose.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
装备您想要体验的职业的说明书，您就可以使用该职业的一些基本技能。
尝试这些技能，然后决定选择哪个职业。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Have you tried the skills in the Manuals?
If you want to hear information about each job, talk to the people dispatched by the Job Guilds.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
您尝试过说明书中的技能了吗？
如果您想了解每个职业的详细信息，请与职业公会的代表交谈。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
I think you've learned enough, do you want to quit and go to your first town?
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
我想您已经学得差不多了，您想结束训练并前往您的第一个城镇吗？

scripts.text: I will stay little longer.
scripts.translation: 我想再待一会儿。

scripts.text: I want to quit and go to the town.
scripts.translation: 我想结束训练并前往城镇。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
It's ok to stay here and practice until you think you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
您可以留在这里练习，直到您觉得自己准备好了为止。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Try using the job manuals to find out the characteristics of each job's skills.
I will restore your HP and SP... Keep it up.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
试着使用职业说明书来了解每个职业技能的特点。
我会恢复您的HP和SP... 加油。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Looks like you are ready.
I guess you have made up your mind, huh?
Well, where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
看起来您准备好了。
我想您已经下定决心了，对吧？
那么，您想去哪里？

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 莫洛奇

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐扬

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Prontera, the Capital city of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
Take care and god bless you on your journey.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
普隆德拉，卢恩·米德加兹王国的首都。
请保重，愿神保佑您的旅途。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
The Desert Town, Morocc...
There's lots of hidden stories within that town.
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
沙漠城镇，莫洛克...
那个城镇里隐藏着许多故事。
请保重。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
You've selected Payon.
God bless you.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
您选择了斐扬。
愿神保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Alberta, the Port City.
It's the main hub of all trades.
If you want to meet with other civilizations, you have to go to Alberta first.
Well then, god bless you on your soul.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
艾尔贝塔，港口城市。
它是所有贸易的主要枢纽。
如果您想接触其他文明，必须先去艾尔贝塔。
那么，愿神保佑您的灵魂。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Geffen, the City of Magic.
Geffen Tower in the middle of the city is nice.
I will send you near the Geffen fountain.
May Goddess Freya bless you.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
吉芬，魔法之城。
城市中央的吉芬塔很漂亮。
我会送您到吉芬喷泉附近。
愿女神芙蕾雅保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Yeah... Think with prudence.
...Meet up with the people from each guild.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
嗯...请慎重思考。
...去见见各个公会的成员吧。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I won't help you until you finish Brade's instructions.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
在您完成布雷德的指示之前，我无法帮助您。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: About Swordman Class.
scripts.translation: 关于剑士职业

scripts.text: Job change to Swordman.
scripts.translation: 转职为剑士

scripts.text: Got any quests?
scripts.translation: 有什么任务吗？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Literally, Swordman means one, who
is specialized in wielding swords.
But they can also choose to use spears if they so choose.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
顾名思义，剑士是专门使用剑的专家。
但他们也可以选择使用长矛。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
We possesses strong physical strength.
So naturally we can equip heavy armors and weapons.
Most weapon classes, except for bows and rods,
are equippable by our class.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
我们拥有强大的体力。
因此，我们可以装备重型护甲和武器。
除了弓和法杖外，我们几乎可以装备所有类型的武器。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
The only weakness of the Swordman class is that they cannot use magic spells.
But we've compensated for that by using elemental weapons.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
剑士唯一的弱点是无法使用魔法。
但我们通过装备属性武器来弥补这一点。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
The merits of being a Swordman is the enormous amount of HP we have.
Most of us can bear the grunt of our enemies' attacks with relative ease.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
成为剑士的优点是拥有大量的HP。
我们大多数人都能轻松承受敌人的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
And we are unrivaled when it comes to one-on-one melee combat.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
在单挑近战方面，我们无人能敌。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Anyone who chooses to be a Swordman will likely play the role of the tank. It is our duty to protect the weak.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
选择成为剑士的人通常会扮演坦克的角色。保护弱者是我们的职责。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
As a Swordman you can advance to a ^8E2323Knight^000000 or ^8E2323Crusader^000000 class as your 2nd class profession.
And just recently third professions have been discovered.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
作为剑士，您可以进阶为^8E2323骑士^000000或^8E2323十字军^000000作为二转职业。
最近还发现了三转职业。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Try the Swordman skills listed in the manual.
Open your skill menu by pressing Alt + S
Make sure it is in list mode by clicking the minimize button on the top right corner of the Skill Menu.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
请尝试手册中列出的剑士技能。
按Alt + S打开技能菜单。
点击技能菜单右上角的最小化按钮，确保它处于列表模式。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
If you're interested in being a Swordman, I'll offer you this manual.
Do you want to try the skills of a Swordman?
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
如果您对成为剑士感兴趣，我会给您这本手册。
您想试试剑士的技能吗？

scripts.text: I'll try the Swordman skills.
scripts.translation: 我想试试剑士技能

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Here is the Swordman manual.
I'll just take any manuals from any other classes you have.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
这是剑士手册。
我会收回您拥有的其他职业的手册。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
After equipping the Manual, open your Skill menu by pressing ALT+S.
Make sure to minimize your Skill tree by clicking the '-' button on the top right corner of the Skill Tree Window.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
装备手册后，按ALT+S打开技能菜单。
点击技能树窗口右上角的“-”按钮，确保技能树处于最小化状态。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Hum. Do you think so?
Ok, I agree with you. Choosing a job is very important in our lives.
Just talk to me whenever you want to experience Swordman skills.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
嗯。您真的这么认为吗？
好吧，我同意您。选择职业在生活中非常重要。
如果您想体验剑士技能，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Do you really want to change your job to Swordman?
If you want to be a Swordman, I'll send you to the Swordman Association immediately.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
您真的想转职为剑士吗？
如果您想成为剑士，我会立即送您去剑士协会。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I think you have enough job levels, of course, right?
Do you want to stop your training now and go to the Swordman Association?
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
我想您的职业等级已经足够了吧？
您现在想停止训练，前往剑士协会吗？

scripts.text: I'll consider it again.
scripts.translation: 我再考虑一下。

scripts.text: I'll go to the Swordman Association.
scripts.translation: 我要去剑士协会。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Please try enough instruction manuals from each job class and consider it carefully.
Of course, you're always welcomed.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
请多尝试各个职业的手册，并仔细考虑。
当然，我们随时欢迎您。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I see.
Then I'll end your training process and send you to the Swordman Guild.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
我明白了。
那么我将结束您的训练流程，并送您去剑士公会。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
You want me to give you a quest?
Umm. Let me see.
Ok! Hunt a couple of Picky monsters around here?
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
您想让我给您一个任务？
嗯...让我看看。
好的！去附近打几只小鸡？

scripts.text:
^4d4dffYou received a hunting request from a staff of the Swordman Guild.
You can check the contents of the quest from the quest information window.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff您收到了来自剑士公会职员的狩猎请求。
您可以在任务信息窗口中查看任务内容。^000000

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Use the 'Bash' skill in the Swordman manual.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available Swordman skills.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
使用剑士手册中的“狂击”技能。
按 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 打开技能树，并点击窗口右上角的 ^4d4dff“-”^000000 按钮以最小化窗口，即可查看可用的剑士技能。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Talk to Trainer Brutus if you want to fight stronger monsters.
I'll wait for you here.
Wish you a good luck.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
如果您想挑战更强的魔物，请去找训练师 布鲁图斯。
我会在这里等您。
祝您好运。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Great.
I think that you're good enough to be a Swordman.
I'll give you some potions as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
很好。
我认为您已经足够优秀，可以成为剑士了。
我会给您一些药水作为奖励。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Hunt two Picky monsters.
You can find them in the more difficult training grounds by talking to Trainer Brutus.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
打两只小鸡。
您可以去找训练师 布鲁图斯，在更困难的训练场中找到它们。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I think you finished that quest already, right?
You'll experience more of these quests as you grow as an adventurer in the world.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
我想您已经完成那个任务了吧？
随着您在这个世界中作为冒险者的成长，您会体验到更多这样的任务。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Your training is now complete.
If you choose to become a Swordman I wish you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
您的训练现已完成。
如果您选择成为剑士，祝您好运。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I'm sorry but I don't have any quests to give you right now.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
很抱歉，我现在没有可以交给您的任务。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
If you have any questions about the Swordman class, please ask me.
The Swordman Guild is waiting for novices like you.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
如果您有关于剑士职业的问题，请随时问我。
剑士公会正等待着像您这样的初心者。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
You look like you are not done with Instructor Brade's lessons.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
您看起来还没有完成指导员 布雷德的课程。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: What is an Acolyte?
scripts.translation: 什么是服事？

scripts.text: Job change to Acolyte.
scripts.translation: 转职为服事。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
An Acolyte is someone who worships the goddess Freya sacrificing themselves to help others.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
服事是崇拜女神芙蕾雅，并牺牲自己来帮助他人的人。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Acolytes use supportive skills to make combat easier.
It is essential to have an Acolyte in any successful party.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
服事使用辅助技能来使战斗变得更容易。
在任何成功的队伍中，服事都是必不可少的。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
^8E2323As an Acolyte, you can upgrade your future job to Priest or Monk^8E2323.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
^8E2323作为服事，你可以将未来的职业转职为牧师或武僧^8E2323。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Try the Acolyte Skills with the manual you have. It will help you understand the job easier.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available skills.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
试着用你手中的说明书体验一下服事的技能吧。这会帮助你更容易地理解这个职业。
按下 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 打开技能树，并点击窗口右上角的 ^4d4dff'-'^000000 按钮最小化窗口，即可查看可用的技能。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
If you want, I can give you a skill manual to experience what it is like to be an Acolyte.
Would you like to experience the skills of an Acolyte?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
如果你愿意，我可以给你一本技能说明书，让你体验一下成为服事的感觉。
你想体验一下服事的技能吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text: No, I'm not interested.
scripts.translation: 不，我没兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Here you go, the instruction manual of an Acolyte.
I will take away those other job's manuals while you study this one.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
给你，这是服事的说明书。
在你研究这本说明书期间，我会收走其他职业的说明书。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Make sure to equip the Skill Manual by double-clicking it in the Inventory Window.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available skills.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
记得在物品栏窗口中双击技能说明书来装备它。
按下 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 打开技能树，并点击窗口右上角的 ^4d4dff'-'^000000 按钮最小化窗口，即可查看可用的技能。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Hum. Do you think so.
Ok, I agree with you. Choosing a job is very important in our life.
Just talk to me whenever you want to know about Acolytes.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
嗯。你是这么想的吗。
好吧，我同意你的看法。选择职业在我们的人生中是非常重要的。
如果你想知道关于服事的任何事，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Do you really want to become an Acolyte?
If you do, I will send you to Prontera's Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
你真的想成为服事吗？
如果是的话，我会送你去普隆德拉的光耀之堂。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Of course, I assume you have enough job levels to become an Acolyte right?
Would you like to quit the Training Process and go to the Prontera's Sanctuary?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
当然，我假设你的职业等级已经足够转职为服事了，对吧？
你想退出训练流程并前往普隆德拉的光耀之堂吗？

scripts.text: Let me reconsider.
scripts.translation: 让我再考虑一下。

scripts.text: I will go to the Sanctuary.
scripts.translation: 我要去光耀之堂。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
You should try out each job's manuals.
Go through them thoroughly and decide carefully.
Of course, I will welcome you anytime.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
你应该尝试一下每个职业的说明书。
仔细研究它们，并慎重决定。
当然，我随时欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
That's great.
Then I will completely end the Training Process and send you to Prontera's Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
太好了。
那么我将完全结束训练流程，并送你去普隆德拉的光耀之堂。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
If you have any questions about Acolytes, please ask me anytime.
Our God, Odin awaits adventurers like you.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
如果你有任何关于服事的问题，请随时问我。
我们的神奥丁正等待着像你这样的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
You look like you are not done with Instructor Brade's lessons.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
看起来你还没有完成指导员 布雷德的课程。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
我能为你做什么？

scripts.text: About the Thief Class.
scripts.translation: 关于盗贼职业。

scripts.text: I want to be a Thief.
scripts.translation: 我想成为盗贼

scripts.text: Got any Quests?
scripts.translation: 有什么任务吗？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Thieves are experts at using Dagger class weapons.
They strike quickly and easily evade attacks from their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
盗贼是短剑类武器的专家。
他们攻击迅速，并能轻松躲避敌人的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Thieves can learn skills that allow them to hide from their enemies or steal items from monsters.
They are also feared for their use of poison, which slowly weakens their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
盗贼可以学习从敌人身边躲藏或从魔物身上偷窃物品的技能。
他们使用毒液的能力也令人畏惧，这会慢慢削弱敌人的力量。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
In jeopardy, or in the case that thieves do not want to reveal themselves,
they can even use their skill to hide themselves easily.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
在危急时刻，或者不想暴露身份时，
他们甚至可以使用技能轻松躲藏起来。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Thieves can change their jobs to ^8E2323Assassins^000000 or ^8E2323Rogues^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
盗贼可以转职为^8E2323刺客^000000或^8E2323流氓^000000。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
The class manual can help you understand what it is to be a Thief by using the skills that are essential to all Thieves.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
职业手册能帮助你理解盗贼这一职业，
通过使用所有盗贼必备的技能来体验。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
If you want, I'll give you a Thief skill manual.
Would you like to experience the skills of a Thief?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
如果你愿意，我会给你一本盗贼技能手册。
你想体验一下盗贼的技能吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I would.
scripts.translation: 是的，我想玩。

scripts.text: No, I don't.
scripts.translation: 没有，我没有。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Here, please take the Thief manual.
I'll just take the other class manuals while I'm at it.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
请收下这本盗贼手册。
顺便把其他职业的手册也收回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Make sure to equip the Skill Manual by double-clicking it in the Inventory Window.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available skills.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
请在物品栏中双击技能手册来装备它。
按下^4d4dffAlt + S^000000打开技能树，
并点击窗口右上角的^4d4dff'-'^000000按钮最小化窗口，即可查看可用技能。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Oh, are you sure?
Class selection is very important so please consider it carefully.
If you want to ask about Thieves, please talk to me any time.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
哦，你确定吗？
职业选择非常重要，请慎重考虑。
如果你想了解盗贼，随时可以来找我。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Do you really want to be a Thief?
If so, I will send you to the Thief Guild immediately.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
你真的想成为盗贼吗？
如果是的话，我会立刻送你去盗贼公会。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
You already reached the required job level, didn't you?
Do you want to finish the Novice training and go to the Thief Guild?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
你已经达到了所需的职业等级，对吧？
你想结束初心者训练，前往盗贼公会吗？

scripts.text: Let me consider it again.
scripts.translation: 让我再考虑一下

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Have you tried all of the class manuals yet?
If you're undecided what job to take on I suggest you try talking to all the Guides first.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
你试过所有的职业手册了吗？
如果你还没决定好要选什么职业，
我建议你先和所有的向导聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Ok, I see.
Welcome. Then your Novice training is totally complete and you will be sent to the Thief Guild immediately.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
好的，我明白了。
欢迎。那么你的初心者训练就完全结束了，
我会立刻送你去盗贼公会。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Quests?
Hmm, what will be good for you?
How about hunting some Willows.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
任务？
嗯，什么适合你呢？
不如去猎杀一些树精吧。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
You can't cheat this so make sure to kill 5 Willows. When you're done come and talk to me again.
If you talk to Trainer Brutus, he can send you to a more difficult training ground where there are Willows to hunt.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
这件事不能作弊，所以务必猎杀5只树精。
完成后再来找我。
如果你去找训练师 布鲁图斯，
他可以送你去一个更难的训练场，那里有树精可以猎杀。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
If you equip the Thief manual, you can have the effect of the skill, Double Attack.
Double Attack and Hide are the main skills of the Thief.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
如果你装备了盗贼手册，就能获得二刀连击技能的效果。
二刀连击和躲藏是盗贼的主要技能。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
You are very strong.
These are not many but let me give you a reward for your effort.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
你很强。
虽然数量不多，但为了你的努力，
让我给你一点奖励吧。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Hunt 5 Willows and then come talk to me to finish your quest.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
猎杀5只树精，然后来找我完成任务。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
I think you finished that quest already, right?
You'll experience more of these quests as you grow as an adventurer in the world.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
我想你已经完成那个任务了，对吧？
随着你在世界中作为冒险者的成长，
你会经历更多这样的任务。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Your training is now complete.
If you choose to become a Thief I wish you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
你的训练现在结束了。
如果你选择成为盗贼，祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
I'm sorry but I don't have any quests to give you right now.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
很抱歉，我现在没有任务可以给你。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
If you have something to ask about the Thief job, feel free to ask me.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
如果你有关于盗贼职业的问题，
尽管问我。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
You are still in the process of training with sir Brad.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
你目前还在布拉德那里接受训练。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
What can I help you with?
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Tell me about Merchants
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于商人的事

scripts.text: I want to be a Merchant.
scripts.translation: 我想成为商人。

scripts.text: Give me a Quest.
scripts.translation: 给我一个任务

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Merchant? Simply put, he sells goods and makes money.
That's the main focus for any Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
商人？简单来说，就是贩卖货物并赚取利润。
这是商人的主要职责。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
We have special skills for making money.
We can buy goods at a lower price
and sell them at a higher price.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
我们拥有特殊的赚钱技能。
我们可以低价买入货物，
然后高价卖出。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Also Merchants can have Carts
that we can store lots of items in.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
此外，商人还可以使用手推车，
里面可以存放大量的物品。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
^8E2323Merchants can transform to a Blacksmith
^8E2323or an Alchemist^000000 as their second job.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
^8E2323商人可以转职为铁匠
^8E2323或炼金术士^000000作为第二职业。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
I think you should test Merchant skills before you decide what to do.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
我认为在决定职业之前，
你应该先体验一下商人的技能。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Do you want to see what it's like to be a Merchant?
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
你想看看成为商人是什么感觉吗？

scripts.text: I want to test Merchant skills.
scripts.translation: 我想体验商人的技能

scripts.text: I don't want to test it.
scripts.translation: 我不想体验

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Here is the Merchant skill manual.
I will take other job manuals from you while I'm at it.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
这是商人技能手册。
顺便我会收回你其他职业的手册。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Make sure to equip the Skill Manual by double-clicking it in the Inventory Window.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available skills.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
请在物品栏窗口中双击技能手册来装备它。
按下 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 打开技能树，
并点击窗口右上角的 ^4d4dff'-'^000000 按钮最小化窗口，
即可查看可用的技能。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Hum. Do you think so.
Ok, I agree with you. Choosing job is very important in our life.
Just talk to me whenever you want to experience Merchant skills.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
嗯。你是这么想的吗？
好吧，我同意你的看法。选择职业在生活中非常重要。
如果你想体验商人的技能，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
You want to be a Merchant?
Ok, then, I will send you to the Merchant Guild's union right away.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
你想成为商人？
好的，那么，我马上送你到商人公会的总部。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Wait, have you checked your Job level?
Do you want to complete your Novice training and go straight to the Merchant Guild's union?
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
等等，你检查过你的职业等级了吗？
你想完成初心者的训练，直接去商人公会的总部吗？

scripts.text: I will think about it again.
scripts.translation: 我再考虑一下

scripts.text: Yes, I want to go to the Merchant Guild's union
scripts.translation: 是的，我想去商人公会的总部

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Ok, I hope you consider being a Merchant.
We are always welcome to have you!
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
好的，希望你能考虑成为商人。
我们随时欢迎你的加入！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
That's great.
Then I will end the Training Process and send you to the Merchant Guild's union immediately.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
太好了。
那么我将结束训练流程，并立即送你前往商人公会的总部。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Huh? Quest??
Humm... What would be suited for you...?
Ok, then bring me ^5d5dff300 zeny^000000 by selling some of your items to the Potato Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
嗯？任务？
嗯...什么适合你呢...？
好的，那就把一些物品卖给土豆商人，给我^5d5dff300 Zeny^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
If you equipped the Merchant manual you have the ability to use the 'Overcharge' and 'Discount' skills.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
如果你装备了商人入门手册，就能使用“高价卖出”和“低价买进”技能。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
I will wait for you here.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
我会在这里等你。
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Excellent!
Zeny is the currency of Midgard.
You can make zeny by selling loot as well as through making smart business decisions.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
太棒了！
Zeny是米德加尔特大陆的货币。
你可以通过出售战利品以及做出明智的商业决策来赚取Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
We can use extremely powerful skills with zeny!
Mammonite! That is our ultimate attack skill!!
We basically paste money on the weapon and then strike the enemy. Death by Zeny! Nyahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
我们可以使用Zeny施展极其强大的技能！
金钱攻击！那是我们的终极攻击技能！！
基本上就是把钱贴在武器上，然后攻击敌人。用Zeny致死！哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
By the way, you have done an excellent job. So, I should give you something... What would be good?
Alright! What about Phracon?
Phracon is a metallic element which you can use for refining weapons.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
顺便说一下，你表现得非常出色。所以我应该给你点什么东西...什么好呢？
对了！强化武器金属-级数一怎么样？
强化武器金属-级数一是一种可用于强化武器的金属元素。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Zeny is the currency of Midgard.
You can make zeny by selling loot as well as through making smart business decisions.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
Zeny是米德加尔特大陆的货币。
你可以通过出售战利品以及做出明智的商业决策来赚取Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
You can get loot by killing monsters. After hunting monsters, you can sell those loot to make a profit!
What a valuable job it is! Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
你可以通过击杀魔物获得战利品。狩猎魔物后，你可以出售这些战利品来获利！
这是一份多么有价值的职业啊！不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Why don't you try to be a Merchant? Making money is not easy but it will be a great experience!
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
你为什么不尝试成为商人呢？赚钱并不容易，但这将是一次很棒的体验！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
You have already completed the quest.
Once you enter the main world, you can get various exciting quests there!
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
你已经完成了任务。
一旦进入主世界，你可以在那里获得各种有趣的任务！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
I think you're strong enough now to change your job right? Hahahaha don't waste too much time here Novice.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
我觉得你现在已经足够强，可以转职了，对吧？哈哈哈哈哈，初心者，别在这里浪费太多时间。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
I'm sorry but I don't have any quests to give you right now.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
很抱歉，我现在没有任务可以给你。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
If you have any questions about Merchants, feel free to ask me.
I think you could be a rich Merchant. AhHahaha.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
如果你有任何关于商人的问题，尽管问我。
我觉得你会成为一名富有的商人。啊哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
You are still in the process of training with sir Brade.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你目前还在布雷德先生那里接受训练。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
What can I help you with?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Tell me about Archers
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于弓箭手的事

scripts.text: I want to be an Archer
scripts.translation: 我想成为弓箭手

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Archers have specialized skills by using a Bow and have a variety of powerful skills.
Archers are good at staying back and picking off their targets.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
弓箭手使用弓箭拥有专门的技能，并且拥有多种强大的技能。
弓箭手擅长在后方保持距离，精准地打击目标。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Archers don't have great
vitality so they have to keep
their distance from enemies.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
弓箭手的体质并不出众，
所以必须与敌人保持距离。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
On the other hand, Archers are attentive and have incredibly accurate eyes.
So once they are ready to attack, they can kill enemies before they're even aware of their presence.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
另一方面，弓箭手观察力敏锐，视力极佳。
一旦准备就绪，他们能在敌人察觉之前将其击杀。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
^8E2323Archers can transform to many second jobs like a Hunter.
Besides Hunters, Archers can transform to a Bard, if they are male.
They can transform to a Dancer, if they are female^000000.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
^8E2323弓箭手可以转职为猎人等二转职业。
除了猎人之外，男性弓箭手可以转职为诗人，
女性弓箭手可以转职为舞娘^000000。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I think you should test Archer skills before you decide what to do.
I can provide you our test skill manual.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
在您决定之前，我建议先体验一下弓箭手的技能。
我可以为您提供我们的技能测试手册。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Do you want to register to test skill experience?
Would like to test Archer skills?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
您想要注册技能体验吗？
想要体验弓箭手的技能吗？

scripts.text: I want to test Archer skills.
scripts.translation: 我想体验弓箭手技能

scripts.text: I don't want to test it.
scripts.translation: 我不想体验

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Here is the Archer manual.
I will take the other job manuals from you while you test the Archer manual out.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
这是弓箭手手册。
在您体验弓箭手手册期间，我会暂时保管您其他的职业手册。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Make sure to equip the Skill Manual by double-clicking it in the Inventory Window.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available skills.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
请确保在物品栏窗口中双击装备技能手册。
按下 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 打开技能树，
并点击窗口右上角的 ^4d4dff'-'^000000 按钮最小化窗口，即可查看可用技能。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Hum. Do you think so.
Ok, I agree with you. Choosing a job is very important in our life.
Just talk to me whenever you want to experience Archer skills.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
嗯。你是这么想的吗。
好吧，我同意你的看法。选择职业对我们的人生非常重要。
如果你想体验弓箭手技能，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
You want to be an Archer?
Ok, then, I will send you to the Archer Guild right away.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你想成为弓箭手？
好的，那么，我马上送你到弓箭手公会。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Wait, have you checked your Job level?
Do you want to complete the Novice training arena and go to the Archer Guild right now?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
等等，你检查过职业等级了吗？
你想完成初心者训练竞技场并立即前往弓箭手公会吗？

scripts.text: I will think about it again.
scripts.translation: 我再考虑一下

scripts.text: Yes, I want to go to the Archer Guilds union
scripts.translation: 是的，我想去弓箭手公会

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Test out all the jobs if you have to but choose Archer because we're the best.
We are always welcome to have you!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
如果你必须的话，可以测试所有职业，但请选择弓箭手，因为我们是最好的。
我们随时欢迎你的加入！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
That's great.
Then I will completely end the Training Process and send you to the Archer Guild.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
太好了。
那么我将结束训练流程，并送你到弓箭手公会。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
If you have any questions about Archers, feel free to ask me.
I think you could be a strong Archer young Novice.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
如果你有任何关于弓箭手的问题，请随时问我。
我想你一定能成为一名强大的弓箭手，年轻的初心者。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
You are still in the process of training with Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你目前仍在指导员 布雷德那里接受训练。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
What can I help you with?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Tell me about Mages
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于魔法师的事

scripts.text: I want to be a Mage
scripts.translation: 我想成为魔法师

scripts.text: Give me a Quest
scripts.translation: 给我个任务

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Mages are those who can use magic when they need to protect their friends.
Mages can curse enemies using the elements of fire, water, earth and thunder magic.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
魔法师是在需要保护朋友时能够使用魔法的人。
魔法师可以使用火、水、土和雷的元素魔法来诅咒敌人。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
However they cannot equip other weapons but staffs and books.
Because they are too delicate
to carry heavy weapons.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
不过他们只能装备法杖和书籍。
因为他们太娇弱了，
无法携带沉重的武器。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
But they can cover this weakness
by their remarkable magic skills.
That is why many people want
to become a Mage!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
但他们可以用卓越的魔法技巧来弥补这一弱点。
这就是为什么很多人想成为魔法师！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Mages have to be in their guild for guild's power and honor.
This is one of reasons why Mages are popular in any parties and guilds.
Why don't you become a Mage?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
魔法师必须加入公会，以增强公会的力量和荣誉。
这也是魔法师在队伍和公会中很受欢迎的原因之一。
你何不成为一名魔法师呢？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
^8E2323Mages can transform to Wizards
^8E2323or Sages as their second job^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
^8E2323魔法师可以转职为巫师^8E2323或贤者^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
I think you should test Mage skills before you decide what to do.
I can provide you with our test skill registration form.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
我想你应该在决定之前先测试一下魔法师的技能。
我可以为你提供我们的技能测试登记表。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Do you want to register to experience how it is to be a Mage?
Would you like to test Mage skills?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你想登记体验一下成为魔法师的感觉吗？
你想测试魔法师的技能吗？

scripts.text: I want to test Mage skills.
scripts.translation: 我想测试魔法师的技能

scripts.text: I don't want to test it.
scripts.translation: 我不想体验

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Here is the Mage Manual.
I will take the other job registration forms and manuals from you.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
这是魔法师入门手册。
我会收回你其他职业的登记表和手册。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
After equipping the Manual, open your Skill menu by pressing ALT+S.
Make sure to minimize your Skill tree by clicking the '-' button on the top right corner of the Skill Tree Window.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
装备好手册后，按ALT+S打开技能菜单。
记得点击技能树窗口右上角的“-”按钮，将技能树最小化。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Hum. Do you think so.
Ok, I agree with you. Choosing a job is very important in our life.
Just talk to me whenever you want to experience Mage skills.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嗯。你是这么想的吗。
好吧，我同意你的看法。选择职业在我们的人生中非常重要。
如果你想体验魔法师的技能，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
You want to be a Mage?
Ok, then, I will send you to the Mage Guild union in Geffen right away.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你想成为魔法师？
好吧，那我马上送你去吉芬的魔法师公会。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Wait, have you checked your Job level?
Do you want to complete your Novice training and go straight to the Mage Guild's union?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
等等，你检查过你的职业等级了吗？
你想完成初心者的训练，直接去魔法师公会吗？

scripts.text: I will think about it again.
scripts.translation: 我再考虑一下

scripts.text: Yes, complete my training.
scripts.translation: 是的，完成我的训练

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Please test what Mage skills are all about before you decide.
We are always welcome to have you!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
请在决定之前先测试一下魔法师的技能。
我们随时欢迎你的加入！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
That's great.
Then I will end the Training Process and send you to the Mage Guild union in Geffen right away.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
太好了。
那么我将结束训练流程，马上送你去吉芬的魔法师公会。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Huh? Quest?
Hmm... What would be suited for you...?
Would you like to hunt Lunatics by using Bolt skills?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嗯？任务？
嗯...什么适合你呢...？
你想用火箭术技能去猎杀疯兔吗？

scripts.text:
^4d4dffYou have received a Hunting quest from the Mage Guide.
You can get more information about the quest from the quest window.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff你从魔法师向导处接到了一个狩猎任务。
你可以在任务窗口中获取更多关于任务的信息。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
You are able to use 'Fire Bolt' skill that is shown on the Mage manual.
I will wait for you here.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你可以使用魔法师入门手册上显示的“火箭术”技能。
我会在这里等你。
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
You have done an excellent job.
So, did you find any interests about Mages?
Alright. I will give something...
Here are Novice Butterfly Wings, please take them.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你做得非常出色。
那么，你对魔法师有什么兴趣吗？
好吧。我会给你一些东西...
这是[非卖品]新手专用蝴蝶翅膀，请收下。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
The quest is that you have to
hunt Lunatics and bring 5 clovers.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
任务是猎杀疯兔，并带回5个三叶草。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
You have already completed the quest.
Once you enter the main world, you can get various exciting quests there!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你已经完成了任务。
一旦进入主世界，你可以在那里接到各种令人兴奋的任务！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
This should be enough for your training.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
这对你的训练来说应该足够了。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
I'm sorry but I don't have any quests to give you right now.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
很抱歉，我现在没有可以给你的任务。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
If you have any questions about Mages, feel free to ask me.
I think you could be a intelligent Mage...
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
如果你有关于魔法师的问题，尽管问我。
我觉得你会成为一名聪明的魔法师...

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Hello?
I'm here to guide you about extra jobs and special classes.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
你好？
我是来指导你关于特殊职业和转职的。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
For special classes, there are Taekwon Boy, Taekwon Girl, Ninja, Supernovice, Gunslinger.
Which job description do you want to hear?
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
特殊职业有跆拳男孩、跆拳女孩、忍者、超级初心者、神枪手。
你想听哪个职业的介绍？

scripts.text: Taekwon
scripts.translation: 跆拳

scripts.text: Ninja
scripts.translation: 忍者

scripts.text: Super Novice
scripts.translation: 超级初心者

scripts.text: Gunslinger
scripts.translation: 神枪手

scripts.text: End the conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
It's a job that usually uses a lot of kicking skills.
It belongs to special class and later you can change your job into Taekwon Master which has much stronger attack skills.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
这是一个通常使用大量踢击技能的职业。
它属于特殊职业，之后你可以转职为跆拳大师，拥有更强的攻击技能。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
There is a secondary class to choose from called Soul Linker which also has strong attacks.
You can decide that later when you get stronger.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
还有一个可选的二次转职职业叫悟灵士，同样拥有强大的攻击能力。
等你变强之后可以再做决定。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Ninja's specialty is rapid movement.
They specialize in using throwing weapons.
