scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
忍者的特长是快速移动。
他们擅长使用投掷武器。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Ninjas are kind of a hybrid class that can use various dodge skills with the capability of both physical and magical attacks depending on their preference.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
忍者是一种混合职业，可以根据喜好使用各种闪避技能，并兼具物理和魔法攻击能力。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The biggest attraction of the stronger Novice, called Super Novice, is their pull to mediocrity.
They are the proverbial Jack-of-all-Trades but Master of none.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
更强的初心者，即超级初心者，最大的吸引力在于其平庸的倾向。
他们是典型的“样样通，样样松”。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Super Novices can learn most of the 1st job class skills.
If you become a Super Novice, you cannot change your job, which is too bad, but you can grow as a very individual character.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
超级初心者可以学习大部分一转职业的技能。
如果你成为超级初心者，将无法转职，这很遗憾，但你可以成长为一个非常独特的角色。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
You can job change directly from Novice to a special class which is optimized for a long-distance attack with guns.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
你可以直接从初心者转职为一种优化了远程枪械攻击的特殊职业。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Gunslingers use all kinds of guns made in 'Einbroch', the city of steel.
I recommend this for those who want to become powerful sharpshooters.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
神枪手使用在钢铁之城“艾音布罗克”制造的各种枪械。
我推荐想要成为强力神射手的人选择这个职业。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
If you need more information,
you can always go to ^2F4F4F'www.ragnarok.co.kr'^000000
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
如果你需要更多信息，
你可以随时访问 ^2F4F4F'www.ragnarok.co.kr'^000000

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
These monsters are all weak and easy to kill. But be careful, a lot of them are aggressive and out for blood!
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
这些魔物都很弱，很容易杀死。但小心，其中很多具有攻击性，且嗜血成性！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
If you think monsters here are too weak for you, I can send you to another training ground where the monsters are stronger than the ones over here.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
如果你觉得这里的魔物太弱了，我可以把你送到另一个训练场，那里的魔物比这里的更强。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
So would you like to try?
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
那么，你想试试吗？

scripts.text: Send me to another Level
scripts.translation: 把我送到另一个等级

scripts.text: What monsters are there?
scripts.translation: 那里有什么魔物？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
I see, then let me guide you to another level. Which level do you want to go to?
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
明白了，让我带你去另一个等级。你想去哪个等级？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
You seem eager to fight.
The monster levels increase with each level of the training grounds.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
你看起来很有战斗欲望。
训练场的每个等级，魔物的强度都会随之增加。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 1 has the weakest monsters.
There you'll find Porings, Drops, and Lunatics.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
第1级的魔物最弱。
那里有波利、土波利和疯兔。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 2 is more challenging.
There you'll find Porings, Lunatics, Willows, and Chonchons.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
第2级更具挑战性。
那里有波利、疯兔、树精和苍蝇。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 3 is the same as Level 2.
There you'll find Porings, Lunatics, Willows, and Chonchons.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
第3级和第2级一样。
那里有波利、疯兔、树精和苍蝇。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 4 has stronger monsters.
There you'll find Willows, Hornets, Pickys, and Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
第4级的魔物更强。
那里有树精、蜂兵、小鸡和绿棉虫。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 5 is the same as Level 4.
There you'll find Willows, Hornets, Pickys, and Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
第5级和第4级一样。
那里有树精、蜂兵、小鸡和绿棉虫。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Hmm...?
Are you worried about going to more challenging places? That's understandable, since you're still a new adventurer. Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
嗯...？
你担心去更具挑战性的地方吗？这很正常，毕竟你还是个新冒险者。祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Welcome to the Training Grounds.
You are now in the outer court yard. Please go inside the castle to begin your training.
scripts.translation:
[训练场卫兵]
欢迎来到训练场。
您现在位于外庭院，请进入城堡开始您的训练。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Come in! I would like to welcome you to the Training Grounds!
In here, you can prepare yourself for your future adventures throughout the Ragnarok world!
scripts.translation:
[训练场卫兵]
请进！欢迎来到训练场！
在这里，你可以为未来在仙境传说世界的冒险做好准备！

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Go, Novice, go!
Fight, and grow stronger! Look towards a brighter tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[训练场卫兵]
去吧，初心者，去吧！
战斗，变得更强！向着更美好的明天前进！

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Eh? Why are you still here?
There are no more courses that you need to take.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
咦？你怎么还在这里？
已经没有你需要修的课程了。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Well, I will let you out of here.
Go find the instructor, Brade.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
好吧，我放你出去。
去找教官布雷德吧。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Eh? Weird?
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
咦？奇怪？

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
The Training Grounds have come under new management...
You seem to have come from the previous management.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
训练场已经换了新的管理者...
你似乎是从旧的管理者那里来的。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You may continue, you should have enough experience if you made it here.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你可以继续，既然你能走到这里，应该有足够的经验了。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
I will send you to any town that you'd like to go to.
Or do you have a favourite profession?
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
我可以把你送到任何你想去的城镇。
或者你有喜欢的职业吗？

scripts.text: Choose Profession.
scripts.translation: 选择职业

scripts.text: Go to Towns.
scripts.translation: 前往城镇

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
What profession would you like to perform?
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你想从事什么职业？

scripts.text: Swordman
scripts.translation: 剑士

scripts.text: Acolyte
scripts.translation: 服事

scripts.text: Thief
scripts.translation: 盗贼

scripts.text: Merchant
scripts.translation: 商人

scripts.text: Archer
scripts.translation: 弓箭手

scripts.text: Mage
scripts.translation: 魔法师

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
That's a great choice!
After you receive all the supplies, I will teleport you to the Swordman Association.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
真是不错的选择！
领取完所有补给品后，我会将你传送到剑士协会。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
The town you will be sent to is called Izlude which is a satellite of Prontera. The Swordman Association is located in the West of town. Please remember this.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
您将被传送到的城镇名为依斯鲁得岛，它是普隆德拉的卫星城。剑士协会位于城镇的西侧。请牢记这一点。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You have chosen
to become an Acolyte.
You will be sent to
the town of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你选择了成为服事。
你将被传送到普隆德拉的城镇。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
The Prontera Sanctuary is located to the North-East in Prontera. Please remember this.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
普隆德拉圣堂位于普隆德拉的东北方。请记好这一点。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You have chosen
to become a Thief.
You will be sent to
the town of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你选择了成为盗贼。
你将被传送到莫洛克的城镇。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
The Thief guild is in the underground 1st floor of a pyramid which is North-West of town. Please remember this.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
盗贼公会位于城镇西北方金字塔的地下1层。请记好这一点。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You have chosen
to become a Merchant.
You will be sent to
the town of Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你选择了成为商人。
你将被传送到艾尔贝塔的城镇。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You have chosen
to become an Archer.
You will be sent to
the town of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你选择了成为弓箭手。
你将被传送到斐扬的城镇。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
The Archer Guild is located to the North-West in Payon. Please remember this.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
弓箭手公会位于斐扬的西北方。请记好这一点。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You have chosen
to become a Mage.
You will be sent to
the town of Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你选择了成为魔法师。
你将被传送到吉芬的城镇。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
The Mage Academy is located in the North-West in town. Please remember this.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
魔法师学院位于城镇的西北方。请记好这一点。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
To what town do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你想去哪个城镇？

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 莫洛奇

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐扬

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Never mind
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You have received all the supplies.
To what town do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你已经收到了所有的补给品。
你想去哪个城镇？

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 莫洛奇

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐扬

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Let me give you
some supplies. Then
you will transported
to the chosen town.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
让我给你一些补给品。
然后你会被传送到选定的城镇。

scripts.text:
^660000List of Supplies^000000
^00003320 Free Tickets for Kafra Storage^000000
^00003330 Free Tickets for Kafra Transportation^000000
^0000331 Novice Cutter^000000
^0000331 Novice Adventurer's Suit^000000

[Hanson]
Please check your inventory
to see if you have received all the supplies listed. Let me briefly inform you about the items you've received.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
请检查你的物品栏，确认是否收到了清单上列出的所有补给品。让我简单介绍一下你收到的物品。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Free tickets for Kafra storage and transportation can be used for Kafra storage and teleport services.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
卡普拉仓库和传送点的免费利用券，可用于卡普拉的仓库服务和瞬间移动服务。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You will now
be teleported.
Good luck,
^A62A2A{0}^000000
and farewell.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
现在即将进行传送。
祝好运，^A62A2A{0}^000000
后会有期。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
I will send you to Prontera, the Capital City.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
我将把你送到首都城市普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
I will send you to Geffen, the City of Magic.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
我将把你送到魔法之城吉芬。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
I will send you to Morocc, the Desert Town.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
我将把你送到沙漠城镇莫洛奇。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
I will send you to Payon, the Mountain Village.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
我将把你送到山间村庄斐扬。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
I will send you to Alberta, the Port City.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
我将把你送到港口城市艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
[Hanson]
Come back when you've made up your mind.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
等你想好了再回来吧。

scripts.text: [Hanson]
scripts.translation: [汉森]

scripts.text:
[Lark]
Have you decided what job you're going to choose?
scripts.translation:
[拉克]
你决定好要选什么职业了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lark]
I've prepared a test to see what's the best job for you, according to your answers.
scripts.translation:
[拉克]
我准备了一个测试，根据你的回答来看看什么职业最适合你。

scripts.text:
[Lark]
How about it?
Would you like to take the test?
scripts.translation:
[拉克]
怎么样？
你想参加测试吗？

scripts.text: Take the test.
scripts.translation: 参加测试

scripts.text: What's the test for?
scripts.translation: 测试是做什么的？

scripts.text: No, thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Lark]
Great!
Let's start the test~
scripts.translation:
[拉克]
太好了！
让我们开始测试吧~

scripts.text:
[Lark]
I will ask you a few simple questions.
Through this test, we will check {0}'s personality and propensity so that we can find the most appropriate job for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉克]
我会问你几个简单的问题。
通过这个测试，我们将检查{0}的性格和倾向，以便为你找到最合适的职业。

scripts.text:
[Lark]
There are 3 different types of tests and a total of 30 questions.
scripts.translation:
[拉克]
共有3种不同类型的测试，总计30个问题。

scripts.text:
[Lark]
What do you think? Will you take the test?
scripts.translation:
[拉克]
你觉得怎么样？要参加测试吗？

scripts.text:
[Lark]
If you haven't decided what job you want yet,
I suggest that you take the test.
scripts.translation:
[拉克]
如果你还没决定好想要什么职业，
我建议你先参加测试。

scripts.text:
[Lark]
Let's start the first test.
Choose the answer that you like the most.
^FF0000There are 5 questions.^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉克]
让我们开始第一个测试。
选择你最喜欢的答案。
^FF0000共有5个问题。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lark]
In the middle of the dark, you're walking on the streets of Prontera when you suddenly hear someone scream.
scripts.translation:
[拉克]
在黑暗中，你走在普隆德拉的街道上，突然听到有人尖叫。

scripts.text: 'Aaaahh!! Don't hurt me ~'
scripts.translation: “啊啊啊！！别伤害我~”

scripts.text:
You run to the place and see someone surrounded by punks. Because of your sudden appearance, the punks are surprised.
What would be your reaction in this situation?
scripts.translation:
你跑向那里，看到一个人被一群朽魔包围。由于你的突然出现，朽魔们感到惊讶。
在这种情况下，你会做出什么反应？

scripts.text: Fight against the punks
scripts.translation: 与朽魔战斗

scripts.text: Cast Magic.
scripts.translation: 施放魔法

scripts.text: Call for Guards.
scripts.translation: 呼叫卫兵

scripts.text: Throw rocks at them.
scripts.translation: 扔石头砸它们

scripts.text:
[Lark]
{0} You have destroyed the street punks.
After clearing up the mess, you approach the person who was being attacked.
Do you think the person who was surrounded by punks is a man or a woman?
scripts.translation:
[拉克]
{0} 你击败了那些朽魔。
清理完现场后，你走向那个被攻击的人。
你认为被朽魔包围的人是男子还是女子？
